note: The reported symptom is present when DXC emits its own defensive SPIR-V-backend diagnostic 'found unregistered decl', raised from DeclResultIdMapper when the backend cannot find a registered result-id for a decl -- here, the static const member FIELD of a partial template specialization referenced from PSMain. This is an ordinary DiagnosticsEngine::Fatal clang::Diag (emitFatalError, tools/clang/lib/SPIRV/DeclResultIdMapper.cpp:1048), not an assert/crash, so internal_failure does not apply; match on the literal diagnostic text instead. This is a presence predicate (not an absence one), so the demoted-invalid-probe vacuous-truth trap that applies to not_contains/not_regex predicates does not apply here: a release that fails to reach this code path for an unrelated reason (rejected profile/flag/HLSL-version) simply does not print this text and correctly scores clean, it does not fabricate a match. bisect's ordinary invalid-probe classification (feature/profile/HLSL-version rejection markers) still applies to trim any release that could not exercise HLSL 2021 partial template specialization for an unrelated reason.
